Offence Description: Penalty for use of unverified weight or measure in transaction, deal or contract
First Offence Penalty: Fine which shall not be less than Rs. 2,000, but which may extend to Rs. 10,000
Second / Subsequent Offence Penalty: Imprisonment for a term which may extend to 1 year and with fine
Officer Authority: Controller of Legal Metrology Maharashtra / Authorized Legal Metrology Officer

Offence Description: Penalty for use of non-standard weight or measure
First Offence Penalty: Fine which may extend to Rs. 25,000
Second / Subsequent Offence Penalty: Imprisonment for a term which may extend to 6 months and with fine
Officer Authority: Controller of Legal Metrology / Authorized Officer

Offence Description: Penalty for manufacturing, packing, importing, distributing or selling non-standard pre-packaged commodities (missing mandatory declarations)
First Offence Penalty: Fine which may extend to Rs. 25,000
Second / Subsequent Offence Penalty: Second offence: Fine up to Rs. 50,000; Subsequent: Fine Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year or both
Officer Authority: Director of Legal Metrology (Central) / Controller of Legal Metrology (Maharashtra)

Offence Description: Penalty for manufacture, packing, import or sale of pre-packaged commodity at price exceeding Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
First Offence Penalty: Fine which may extend to Rs. 2,000 for retail dealer
Second / Subsequent Offence Penalty: Fine which may extend to Rs. 2,000
